svg.title: Puck meets a skater
svg.text: How a skater meets a loose puck (Genesis)
To scale, with the game's own picture: a skater standing, facing up the page. A puck can go right through him.
tested only while the puck is within
22 of his body, up or down the screen
stick: within 14 of the blade
but past 22 ahead: never tested
body: circle of 8
By the puck's height
0-5: his stick (if not rising)
takes it if slow enough, else deflects
6-8: passes through him
the body tests only 1 frame in 16
9-16: hits his body
bounces off; a fast one above 12 knocks him over
above 16: over everyone
no test at all
ice
Catching: a stick takes a loose puck slower than 13,000 + 350 x Stick Handling (13,000 flat while a shot's flag stands); faster, it deflects.
Its own no-touch timer also blinds a stick: 16 frames after shooting or passing, 8 after a bounce off him, 2 s after a fall.
Recorded (fast loose pucks within 8 of a skater): at 0-5 high 82% went straight through; at 6-8, 94%; above 16, all.
Skating with the puck his blade is 24-28 ahead, so a puck he loses can sit on his stick untouched. The SNES searches 40, so it doesn't happen there.
